references.text: The opposite curse: the basket and the kneading trough shall be cursed, illustrating the contrast between blessing and curse in this chapter.
The Israelites carried dough troughs on their shoulders when they left Egypt, a reminder of God's provision and blessing over their food.
The promise of an abundance of bread as part of the covenant blessings for obedience to God.
Solomon's blessing over the people includes a prayer that God would bless all they do, including their daily bread.
God's promise to bless Zion's storehouses with abundance and satisfy the poor with bread.
